== Summary ==
Players Committee errata slip for You Do Have Your Moments, cut unchanged at 300 dpi from page 26 of the PC's ''Decipher Errata'' sheet “Official text as of March 1, 2017” (PDF made 31 May 2017): [http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DErrata.pdf DErrata.pdf]. Preserved copy of the sheet: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705005900/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DErrata.pdf Internet Archive]. SHA-1 of this file: 4a50d7bc974f517601596c9fe82633d9e9cc2641. Shown on [[You Do Have Your Moments (PC Errata 2017 slip)]].
